findings.title: Final visual remediation logs an invalid SVG viewBox
findings.user_consequence: A real Chromium run emitted a console error while exercising the maintained visual remediation path; malformed SVG geometry or noisy runtime feedback may affect trust and rendering diagnostics.
findings.suspected_root_authority: Component-generated SVG viewBox serialization in the maintained visual remediation path; exact renderer source not proven by this inspection.

findings.title: Process Health from Data First produced an empty wafer evidence region in the maintained Stage D benchmark
findings.user_consequence: The synthetic engineering workflow rendered zero wafer dies and no primary evidence area, causing the benchmark assertion to fail despite no browser errors; a user could reach a visually empty critical evidence region.
findings.suspected_root_authority: Data First mapping/fixture-to-WaferFabEngine hydration or renderer fallback; direct data-backed wafer acceptance passes, so scope is localized and root cause is not established.

findings.title: Promoted WaferFab entries fail the maintained generic visual-utilization gate
findings.user_consequence: The generic final-remediation fixture produced zero marks for four promoted WaferFab entries; those fixture states fail family utilization and could present as empty visuals without compatible data.
findings.suspected_root_authority: Maintained generic fixture coverage for promoted fab elements versus the renderer’s data contract; specialized real-data Chart Studio checks pass.

findings.title: Bounded computed contrast sample contains below-threshold text
findings.user_consequence: The audit measured 3.06:1 for New report/Duplicate/Manage and 4.42:1 for sampled KPI values against the bounded 4.5:1 small-text threshold; some users may experience weaker text legibility.
findings.suspected_root_authority: Computed text/surface token pairing in the light editor shell or metric styling; this is not a complete WCAG conformance result.

findings.title: Data First benchmark records an explicit creation-choice step after profiling
findings.user_consequence: The maintained benchmark records this as top friction, adding a deliberate choice after profiling; this may increase novice working-memory load, while preserving explicit user control.
findings.suspected_root_authority: Maintained Data First flow interaction design; no universal task-time SLA or comparator was applied.

reason: Screenshots require independent human visual review.
